purpose: Stage 1 of CFRTI-K: the settled KXBTC15M market lists (ticker, close_time, floor_strike, result) for the development window, so stage 2 can name every market. No price is read. Bounded at the cutoff: nothing on or after 2026-11-05T00:00Z is requested.
heldout: CFRTI-K: closes on or after 2026-11-05T00:00:00Z are held-out and are not requested (max_close_ts = 1793836800 on the live list). The historical list has no date filter; the builder drops any market closing at or after the cutoff and the reader never opens it.
notes: Live list: settled KXBTC15M with close time from 2026-06-01 to before 2026-11-05, newest first, up to 14 pages of 1,000 (about 5,100 live markets after the 2026-09-12 cutover, so about 6 pages). Historical list: up to 14 pages (about 7,900 older markets, about 8 pages). Request count: 2 requests, at most 28 pages, cap 30. Fields the reader keeps: ticker, close_time, floor_strike, cap_strike, result.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
